pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:205 The exporter's FoundryError is turned into an AppError with only its message and no `cause`, and any status missing from FOUNDRY_CODE falls into `internal`. publicError then logs that defect with `e.cause ?? ""`, so the stack is gone, and a status nobody mapped gets reported as a bug instead of as an unrecognised failure.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:205 The category is picked from the structured status at birth, which is right, but the original error is replaced, not wrapped: no `{ cause: e }` is passed, though ErrorOptions2 supports it.

app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:134 It maps onto the closed AppErrorCode set, but unmapped statuses (500, 422, 429...) fall into `internal`, which the domain defines as 'a bug or unclassified failure'. The standard keeps the catch-all and the internal class apart, and this merges them.

app/(studio)/library/_port/handoff.ts:16 When the kernel store fails to open, the code returns a fallback value and reaches no door. On the next line, any readStyle failure, not just not-found, is read as 'try the next candidate'. Downstream code may surface the failure again, but this site does not.
app/(studio)/library/_port/actions.ts:44 Every Library verb goes through the one action core. Its Result is sent to the user as an envelope, and `internal` is logged under a ref.

app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:183 Refusal copy is written at each call site, and the same sentence is spelled again in fixture.ts:226. No registry holds it and no suggestion (e.g. refetch) is attached, so a wording fix needs two edits.
app/(studio)/library/_port/contract.ts:63 The serialised boundary to the client gives the client a closed `code` it can branch on, not prose.
app/(studio)/library/_port/fixture.ts:196 The only per-item decode here runs over the fixture's own generated corpus, which is not externally owned. Even so, the failure label carries the item id.

app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:206 In this taxonomy `internal` is the default fall-through: unknown throws are rethrown to runAction and classified as internal. The technique says not to apply it in that case.
